description: This file defines a trait 'CalculatesChecksumTrait' used for checksum calculations within the AWS S3 client library, including methods for encoding values with different algorithms and handling CRT extension availability.

classes.name: CalculatesChecksumTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing checksum calculation methods for AWS S3 client, supporting multiple algorithms with optional CRT acceleration.

methods.name: getEncodedValue
methods.description: Calculates and encodes a checksum for a given value using specified algorithm, supporting CRC32C, CRC32, SHA256, and SHA1.
